- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] I have executed `npm run verify:staging` and it passes cleanly.
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`cd server && npm test`).
- [ ] I have not committed any real secrets, tokens, or API credentials.
- [ ] React production client build succeeds (`cd client && npm run build`).
